rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 30 h Category A: seminars, workshops, home study offered or approved by APA, ASPPB, NASP, National Register, ABPP, AMA, APA (psychiatric), NASW, NBCC, ACA, AAMFT, ANA/ANCC, BACB, NH Psychological Association, state/county psychological or medical societies, psychology board-approved entities, accredited university departments; graduate courses (1 semester h = 6 h). Max 10 h Category B
rules.audit_note: OPLC audits under Plc 308.04(d); previously 5% random audit, documentation within 30 days.
rules.notes: License expires the last day of the month 2 years after issue. 6 h ethics must be Category A and live/interactive; other CE may be remote or in person. Category B: non-qualifying CE, publications, workshops for the public, non-graduate teaching. Psyc 402.02 readopted 9/4/2026 (OPLC audit wording).
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Psyc 401.01, Psyc 402.01, Psyc 402.02; RSA 329-B:10
